instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Indoors in a living room, an elderly woman in the light purple t-shirt (R1) and an elderly man in the blue t-shirt (R2) sit side-by-side on a green mat on the floor. The elderly woman (R1) sits on the left, looking straight ahead with a somber expression. The elderly man (R2) sits on the right, arms crossed over his raised knee, also looking forward with a sad, contemplative gaze. Soft natural light illuminates the scene, highlighting the warm neutral background of a sofa and potted plant.
